The reference's two interleaved even/odd store-pointer chains prove the zeroed range skips exactly one offset: 0x140 (not 0x142, an earlier hand-guess this session that measured byte-identically to 0x140's omission on raw counts alone -- the +2/+3 stride-jump position in the aligned disassembly is what actually distinguishes them, and 0x140 is the position that resolves every previously-marked instruction in the store-chain region). The u8 zero=0 local is hoisted to function scope (not per-iteration), matching the reference's r9-resident constant kept live across the whole loop.
